verdict.rationale: Railway supports unlimited environments and per-PR preview deployments, which effectively let users test in isolated, non-production environments (railway-docs-11, railway-docs-12). However, there is no explicit documentation of data isolation guarantees, seeded/synthetic data for sandboxes, or AI-agent-specific sandbox tooling tied to this workflow. missing for 10: explicit data-isolation/anonymization guarantees for sandbox environments, AI-agent-specific sandbox/test workflow documentation, independent confirmation that preview environments never touch production data.
